name: recut-rerun-l4
setup: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/mdnaseif/hafith.git /content/hafith_src && pip install -q -e /content/hafith_src && pip install -q 'transformers>=4.45,<5' && echo HAFITH_INSTALLED
